cur: India already asks for more. Section 143(3)(i) of the Companies Act, 2013 has the auditor report on whether internal financial controls with reference to financial statements are adequate and operating effectively, for listed and unlisted companies alike. Private companies are exempt if they are one person or small companies, or have turnover under INR 50 crore or borrowings under INR 25 crore, and are up to date with their filings (MCA notification G.S.R. 583(E), June 13, 2017). A US parent that drops its attestation may still have an Indian subsidiary whose auditor reports on controls every year.
